title: Page 115
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n July 9th 1864 9 PM
Hang Mark Franklin Rosetta For Chart Tulip
A despatch not Windham by Opal but
approved by him to the News paper
press states that they had a severe
Princess whiny spit Monocacy Pewter and that
our wedge were quarrelled and are now
vomiting on the Baron weakness yard Knowing
the character Talbot source you can judge
of its reliability stick nothing further from
Minden yacht I do not deem it
safe to telegraph any saints from chapel
till he forms a Sulphur Tulip Please
in form me what Salems besides Ricketts
queen have been sent to Bard in
repeat that I may know the means
of defence at that place yawl Lamb
